notes.title: Rogue Lords 1.1.04.10 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38037196/776414dd44abcdc1be5c2289237a10f061013403.png[/img]

Greetings Disciples, 

We only like it when the Devil is cheating, not the game, so we've pushed a small patch to Rogue Lords that should address a couple of nasty bugs that have been negatively impacting player experience. Let us know how this influences your experience moving forward.
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1][list][*] Fixed an issue in the Fanatic fight in which killing the Fanatic first made its allies invincible on one health bar when it shouldn't.
[*] Fixed a random issue in which statuses and effects could be repeated too many times.
[*] Fixed a softlock linked to the unlock of an achievement for Headless Horseman.[/list]
See you in Hell!
[i]
The Rogue Lords team[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.1.04
notes.content:
Greetings Disciples,

Our team is pleased to bring you a new update for Rogue Lords. In today's update we are improving the overall performances of the game, you can read the changes through the Patch Notes below.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced camera stuttering on the World Map
[*] Loading times have been reduced
[*] The game is now managing your RAM more efficiently
[*] Multiple bugs have been fixed[/list]

See you in Hell!

[i]The Rogue Lords team[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.1.01
notes.content:
Greetings Disciples,

The development team has worked on a brand new update of Rogue Lords, which is now available to download on your Steam client! In this update, we are addressing issues that you've reported us and improving controls while using a gamepad.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Achievement “Immortal Power”, it should now correctly ignore skills casted by enemies[/list]
[h2]User Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Skill Replacement soul bonus not being displayed in any language other than English
[*] Minor fixes on AP Display using specific Relics
[*] Improved the way the Relics user interface updates when gaining souls in certain part of the game
[*] In combat, the text “Vulnerable” should now be correctly displayed instead of 0/X on characters life gauges after exiting the Devil Mode[/list]				
[h2]Devil Mode[/h2]
[list]
[*] When reloading a Book (run), rerolling a secondary activity or creating a Portal should now correctly close the Devil UI when applying the modifications
[*] Fixed a bug where using the Devil to modify a test success chances in an event could block progression
[*] Leaving an Event with the Devil Mode active should no longer cause the Devil Mode effect to be enabled on the next Event, Sacrificial Altar or Trader activity[/list]			
[h2]Combat[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed The Creature’s Berzerker attribute not being taken in Overpower damage calculation				
[*] Hecate’s rituals will not trigger status that triggers on skill cast when being triggered at the beginning of a turn
[*] Fixed some bosses Skills that were sometimes not displaying the correct amount of damage[/list]		
[h2]World Map[/h2]
[list]
[*] When reloading a new Book (run) just after having defeated a boss, zone paths should not open before completing the first activity anymore
[*] Fixed a bug on the World Map where Disciples could backtrack and take another zone exit leading to the void after reloading a game
[*] Fixed a bug where the tutorial asking to create a Portal could be postponed to the next zone, blocking progression[/list]
[h2]Gamepad/Controller[/h2]
[list]
[*] In combat when playing with a gamepad, when deselecting the currently selected Disciple, he / she will now stay highlighted for selection and can be reselected without having to move the joystick
[*] In combat when playing with a gamepad, when no Disciple is selected, it is now possible to select the first available Disciple with the left bumper (L1 / LB). Only the right bumper could be used before
[*] In combat when playing with a gamepad, when exiting the devil mode, the character that was hovered before entering the devil mode should now be directly selectable
[*] Improved input handling to display Relics tooltips with L2 / LT and R2 / RT buttons[/list]		
[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved application launch time
[*] Fixed Relic Soul Drinker not giving souls when gaining soul while replacing a skill
[*] Fixed a bug where it was possible to open the options menu while resuming the last run from the Devil’s Lair[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.1.00
notes.content:
[i]Update November 22: The following fixes have been added through a hotfix during the weekend.
[list]
[*] Fixed a blocking issue when using Devil Mode and moving specific statuses
[*] Fixing the "Portal enthusiast" achievement description[/list][/i]
Greetings Disciples,

We're pleased to let you know that a new update for Rogue Lords (v.1.1.00) is now available to download on your Steam client! This update is adding the [b]Apprentice Mode[/b], offering a new, more accessible experience to all of you especially if you had trouble overcoming certain battles. Not only are the enemies less powerful but you will start with a nice gift from the Devil in the form of more Diabolic Essence but also Terror.

Through this update we've also implemented a few bug fixes most notably on Achievements and Relics.

As always, feel free to share your feedback on the Steam forums or on [url=discord.gg/RogueLords]Discord[/url] about the changes made in that update, our team is looking with great care at it to improve the game!

Read the Patch Notes below to learn more about the update's content.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Difficulty Modes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new difficulty mode: [b]Apprentice[/b]
[*] The current difficulty mode is now called Normal mode
[*] In Apprentice mode, the player start with +50 Diabolic Essence, +1 Terror, and enemies deal less damage
[*] Books can be unlocked in Apprentice mode
[*] Achievements can be unlocked in Apprentice mode
[*] Experience gains in Apprentice mode are the same as Normal mode[/list][i]Developers' note: Apprentice mode offers a more accessible experience for those struggling with Normal mode or simply wanting a place to experiment with builds and characters more easily. While the Normal difficulty mode remains the game's intended experience, we hope this addition gives everyone a place to enjoy Rogue Lords at their own pace.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38037196/9d4fb151728531d192218de0d8d5c627a7c863bd.png[/img]

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Baron Samedi “What's yours is mine” achievement behaviour with the relic “Old-world amulet”[/list]
[h2]Relics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Anticipation Brooch relic sometimes not triggering on some preparation skills
[*] Updated the visibility of some relics in game compartments (world map and/or event and/or combat)
	• Bloody cleaver
	• Corrupted talisman
	• Netherworld crow
	• Crystal ball
	• Cursed apple
	• Cursed sword
	• Cursed wand
	• Dreamcatcher
	• Glass shield
	• Ouija board
	• Scapegoat
	• Shadow shroud
	• Soul stone
	• Styx jet stone
[*] Added relics in the second pool of relics obtained in a run[/list]
[h2]Localization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed many double line break in the middle of texts and line break at the end of texts
[*] Fix Fanatic’s Worship status infotip displayed in French[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Skills that hit all combatants now behave correctly when a character wields the Provocation status
[*] Several memory management improvements, the game should now use less RAM		
[*] Fixed tutorial bubbles not pointing at the correct UI element when playing with a controller
[*] Fixed camera shakes not being played correctly on some animations
[*] The game should now be able to restore a previous save in case of save data corruption due to a crash[/list][i]Note: this is not a retroactive change, if you have an issue with your save file please [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1069690/discussions/0/3084394448737853377/#c3084394448737909378]follow the steps given in that Discussion[/url].[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.05
notes.content:
Greetings Disciples,

We're pleased to let you know that our first Balancing update for Rogue Lords (v.1.0.05) is now available to download on your Steam client!

Thanks to the feedback you have shared us since the launch of the game, we have been have been working hard on improvement the overall experience! Today's update is addressing a lot of balancing issues related to Enemies (for instance through a complete rework of the Fanatic), Disciples but also of certain Relics.

Our team will continue to monitor your feedback to improve the overall experience through additional updates, we will share more details in the future about them!

[i]Addendum 29/10/2021: Added the following fix to the Fanatic: The Fanatic will now appear only with the 2 same allies (instead of a random between 3 allies compositions)[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2=Enemies]Enemies Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced enemies HP and SP increase between Chapter 5 and Chapter 6 from +37.5% to +12.5% in all Books.[/list]
[h3][b]REWORKED[/b]: The Fanatic[/h3]

[i]Developers' note: These changes aim to keep the spirit of this combat, while making him defeatable by a single-elemental team, but maintaining a big advantage in having both elements or cheating in Devil Mode.[/i]	
[list]
[*] Fanaticism is now a global effect.
[*] The Fanatic has 5 charges of Immortality.
[*] Reducing him to 0 in a gauge (HP or SP) makes him lose a charge of Immortality, refill this gauge completely, makes him invulnerable in this gauge for 1 turn, and makes other allies vulnerable on the other gauge for 1 turn.
[*] VFX and descriptions have been adjusted accordingly.
[*] The Fanatic will now appear only with the 2 same allies (instead of a random between 3 allies compositions).[/list]
[h3]Mistress of Ceremonies[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased Crowd skills cast requirement to rally from 8 to 10.[/list]
[h3]Captain[/h3]	
[list]
[*] Reduced Captain passive damage buff from 2 to 1.[/list]
[h3]Sisters Polaris[/h3]	
[list]
[*] Polarized SP and Polarized HP now have an infinite duration, until being replaced.
[*] These icons now have a touch of color to make them easier to identify.[/list]
[h3]Avenger[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage reduction from Black Hatred has been reduced from 8 to 6.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2=Disciples]Disciples Balancing[/h2]

[h3][b]The White Lady[/b][/h3]

[h4]Torment Mask[/h4]
[list]
[*] Can no longer inflict damage to a target already slated for death.
[*] Reduced base damage from 7 to 6.[/list]
[h4]Intermission (recharge skill)[/h4]
[list]
[*] Triggers the mask she is wearing.
[*] Remove the mask.
[*] Now has the attribute “Cadence” (can be cast only once per turn).[/list]
[h3][b]Headless Horseman[/b][/h3]

[h4]Introspection (recharge skill)[/h4]
[list]
[*] Add +1 Bitterness.[/list]
[h4]Public Execution[/h4]
[list]
[*] Fixed a few invulnerability-bypass cases.[/list]
[h3][b]Dr. Frankenstein[/b][/h3]

[h4]Recharge skill[/h4]
[list]
[*] Swap the Doctor’s HP and SP.
[*] Swap the target’s HP and SP.
[*] Now has the attribute “Cadence” (can be cast only once per turn).[/list]
[h3][b]Bloody Mary[/b][/h3]

[h4]Seven Years Of Bad Luck[/h4]
[list]
[*] Reduced the amount of Depression applied from 2/4/6 to 1/2/3.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2=Relics]Relics Balancing[/h2]

[i]Developers' note: The pool of relics choice for the first few Elites and Terror levels rewards has been adjusted. Those adjustments were made to the first 3 relics discovery (elites+terror) pool:
[list]
[*] Relics too weak, too strong, or not impacting enough for the build were removed
[*] Relics that match better (strong but not too much, and impacting the build) have been added
[*] Augmented the pool quantity to provide more diversity in the builds, and more replayability from run to run[/list][/i]
[h4]Staff of Storms[/h4]
[list]
[*] Can no longer inflict damage to a target already slated for death.
[*] Reduced base damage from 5 to 4.[/list]
[h4]Cursed watch[/h4]
[list]
[*] Reduced AP bonus from 2 to 1.[/list]
[h4]Netherworld Crow[/h4]
[list]
[*] Reduced cost of cheating from 3 to 2.[/list]
[h4]Cursed Sword[/h4]
[list]
[*] Reduced cost of cheating from 3 to 2.[/list]
[h4]Glass Shield[/h4]
[list]
[*] Adjusted its Chapter apparition timing.
[*] Now changes current and max Essence to 30.[/list]
[h4]Bloody Cleaver[/h4]
[list]
[*] Increased bonus physical damage from +1 to +2.[/list]
[h4]Ration Coupon[/h4]
[list]
[*] Increased souls gain from 50 to 80.[/list]
[h4]Shadow Shroud[/h4]
[list]
[*] Increased souls gain from 15 to 30.
[*] Increased bonus to all social characteristics from +1 to +2.[/list]
[h4]Pocket Mirror[/h4]
[list]
[*] Will now also place the mirror at the beginning of a new wave.[/list]
[h4]Corrupted talisman[/h4]
[list]
[*] Now changes current and max Essence to 30.
[*] Adjusted its Chapter apparition timing[/list]
[h4]Receptacle of Torments[/h4]
[list]
[*] Now gives +1 spiritual damage for the rest of the combat instead of +4 for the turn
[*] Now specify that it doubles base damage of listed statuses.[/list]
[h4]War Tattoos[/h4]
[list]
[*] Now gives +1 physical damage for the rest of the combat instead of +4 for the turn
[*] Now specify that it doubles base damage of listed statuses.[/list]
[h4]Bookmark[/h4]	
[list]
[*] [b]Additional effect[/b]: each chapter, it offers +1 Physical Damage to the relic’s holder.[/list]
[h4]Soul Stone[/h4]
[list]
[*] Now specify that it also increases current Diabolic Essence.[/list]
[h4]Damnation mantra[/h4]
[list]
[*] [b]Additional effect[/b]: the holder reduces all incoming Physical Damage by 4.[/list]
[h4]Demonic Sting[/h4]
[list]
[*] Increased bonus physical damage from 3 to 4.[/list]
[h4]Condemned Souls[/h4]
[list]
[*] Can no longer give more than 36 Souls per combat.[/list]
[h4]Cursed Apple[/h4]
[list]
[*] Increased Essence gain from +5 to +8.
[*] Increased bonus to all social characteristics from +1 to +2.[/list]
[h4]Temporal Ruby[/h4]
[list]
[*] Increased the amount of unused AP kept for the next turn from 3 to 5[/list]
[h4]Soul Sponge[/h4]
[list]
[*] Reduced Essence Diabolic healing from 4 to 3.[/list]
[h4]Chalice of Blood[/h4]
[list]
[*][b]New text[/b]: Increase the amount of healing done by Disciples by X[/list]
[h4]Ghostly Veil[/h4]
[list]
[*] Increased bonus spiritual damage from 2 to 4.
[*] Now specify that enemies also get this bonus.
[*] Adjusted its Chapter apparition timing.[/list]
[h4]Bloody Metronome[/h4]
[list]
[*] Removed current effects.
[*] [b]New effect[/b]: each time Mary plays 4 skills in a turn: +3 damage to other allies.[/list]
[h4]Rotten Tooth (Creature)[/h4]	
[list]
[*] Removed current effects.
[*] [b]New effect[/b]: each time Decomposition inflicts damage, +1 damage to Decomposition for the rest of the combat (max +30).[/list]
[h4]Mask of thorns[/h4]
[list]
[*] Can no longer trigger more than once per turn.[/list]
[h4]Iron Maiden[/h4]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing the damage to be tripled instead of doubled.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2=Bugs]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare bug where you could carry a skill you left at the Soul Trader from one run to another
[*] Fixed a rare crash that could happen when using the "Cursed Watch" relic.
[*] Hecate now always correctly play her animations when hit while performing a ritual
[*] The Devil Mode now correctly close itself when you are asked to open the Spellbook in the Tutorial
[*] Fixed an issue that made it possible to open the Spellbook or the Map and buy a skill to the Soul Trader at the same time
[*] You will now correctly be awarded Souls when reloading and winning an ambush fight
[*] Fixed a typo in English in a Witch Stake event
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Misc changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Renamed “Terror notch” to “Terror level”.
[*] Added information about Terror gain and the number of chapters on the red thread node on the Minimap.
[*] Added information about elite ranks on the elite node on the Minimap.[/list]

notes.title: Development Update: Upcoming Balancing changes
notes.content:
Greetings Disciples,

We wanted to give you some insight about our the development of the next update for Rogue Lords.

As mentioned in the past, the main focus of our Development Team for the next updates will be to balance out the overall difficulty through various changes following your feedback.

Among what we are currently working on to implement we can already confirm to you that there will be:

[list]
[*] Rework & tweaks on some Elite enemies (we see you Fanatic!)
[*] Tweaks on Disciples abilities
[*] More balancing on Status and Relics
[*] Additional bug fixes[/list]
We will share with you the complete list of changes through our Patch Notes once the update is available [b]next week[/b].

Thank you all for your support and feedback, we shall see you soon in Hell!

[i]The Rogue Lords team[/i]

tags.balance_change: Rework & tweaks on some Elite enemies (we see you Fanatic!)
Tweaks on Disciples abilities
More balancing on Status and Relics

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.04
notes.content:
Greetings Disciples,

We're pleased to let you know that a new update for Rogue Lords (v.1.0.04) is now available to download on your Steam client!

The goal of this scheduled update (as we [url=https://twitter.com/RogueLords/status/1443509655943135234]announced it[/url] back when game released) was to add the support of [b]Brazilian-Portuguese[/b] but our team also worked on including in this update some additional fixes and improvements which you can find in the Patch Notes below.

Finally, as we previously announced in our latest update - the next focus of our team from now on shall be on balancing the game experience of the game. We should start to roll out those updates starting soon!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Languages[/h3]
[list]
[*] Addition of Brazilian-Portuguese support[/list]
[h3]Events[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a blocking issue in event “Heart stealer” in Spanish
[*] Fixed a blocking issue in a version of the event “Deadman" in Spanish
[*] Fixed a blocking issue in event “Cabinet Of Wonders” in English[/list]
[h3]World Map[/h3]
[list]
[*] Swamp zones should not have paths blocked by the fog anymore
[*] Lakes should not block zone exits anymore[/list]
[h3]Battles[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed VFX and SFX missing on Caleb Attacks
[*] Available targets should now be correctly highlighted when selecting a skill in combat
[*] Fixed an issue with the damage calculation for the summoned enemies[/list]
[h3]Disciples[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a display bug in Hecate’s Nocturnal ritual Tooltips and status icons[/list]
[h3]User Interface[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an unwanted Character tooltip sometimes appearing on the Game Over/Victory screen
[*] Added several new sound effects on the Game Over/Victory screen[/list]
[h3]Relics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Relics should now correctly be awarded when earning the 4th Terror point after a reloaded fight[/list]
[hr][/hr]
Thank you for all of your messages, your comments continue to be helpful to the development team to improve the quality of the game! Be sure to join our Discord (discord.gg/RogueLords) and to follow us on Twitter (Twitter.com/RogueLords) for updates about the game!

See you soon in Hell!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.03
notes.content:
Hello Disciples,

A new update for Rogue Lords is now available to download through your Steam client. This update (v.1.0.03) addresses some of the issues the community reported to us such as a fix on achievements “The Devil is invulnerable”, blocking issues on multiple events and more. You can read the Patch Notes below to learn more about its content.

Finally, we know that many of you have addressed concerns about the game balancing. Please know that we have analysed the data and feedback and are currently investigating potential fixes and solutions. This will become our focus in upcoming updates.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Achievements[/h3]
[list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.02
notes.content:
Dear Disciples,

Our first fix update for Rogue Lords is now available to download through your Steam client. This update (v.1.0.02) addresses some of the issues the community reported to us such as a fix on the SFX writing sound, infinite loading screen and much more. You can read the Patch Notes below to learn more about its content.

Please note that we read every message posted on our forums and feedback sections of our Discord and heard your concerns about various parts of the game. We will let you know what solutions we will apply as soon as they are ready! More bugfix patches for the remaining issues are also on their way.


[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Relics[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Brasero of Hell" no longer creates unusable action points
[*] "Cursed Watch" now gives 2 AP every 2 turns as described
[*] "Soul Drinker" will no longer heal devil essence when losing souls from any source[/list]
[h3]Saves[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the infinite loading after closing the game on the defeat screen
[*] Fixed saves becoming corrupted and the main menu loading infinitely when force closing the game[/list]
[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed last lines not being properly voiced in the epilogue and conclusion books of The Spinning Wheels of the Fates
[*] Fixed last lines not being properly voiced in the epilogue book of The Collar of Cerberus
[*] Fixed last lines not being properly voiced in the epilogue book of The Eye of The Wyvern
[*] Fixed the writing SFX looping throughout the whole game[/list]
[h3]Spellbook[/h3]
[list]
[*] You are now able to open the Spellbook when interacting with a Styx Fountain
[*] You are now able to open the Spellbook when rewarded with Skills during an event[/list]
[h3]Events[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where some events choices were not giving out any rewards
[*] Fixed a blocking issue in Russian in the event “White Morning”
[*] Fixed a blocking issue in Polish in the event “Scarecrow”
[*] Fixed movement not being blocked while receiving a Quest
[*] Fixed a bug where the game could crash in an event when the threat effect that locks a choice was active[/list]
[h3]Tutorial[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a blocking situation in the tutorial when the Devil Mode is active when the Devil Portal Tutorial triggers
[*] Fixed a situation in which the Skill Enhancement Tutorial could be skipped
[*] Fixed a combination of keyboard and mouse allowing to bypass some Tutorial instructions, creating a blocker
[*] Fixed a bug that granted a Book victory instead of a defeat when losing a run just after completing the tutorial[/list]
[h3]Options[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed keybinding not being registered properly
[*] Fixed options not saving properly when using the Reset button
[*] Fixed a bug preventing options in tabs other than “Playability” from being edited[/list]
[h3]Localization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted fallback font size for missing characters (example: polish diacritics)
[*] Fixed various typos in French and English[/list]
[h3]Battles[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would prevent you from continuing to the victory screen when defeating a boss (ex: you can properly defeat Gabriel with the White lady)
[*] Fixed a case where locked action points would make some skill unusable. (ex: Double Mass Awakening no longer crashes the game)
[*] Fixed a bug where Lilith’s alternate passive would lose all its stacks when ending a turn. The charges are now feedbacked on the relic which gives the passive.[/list]
[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed lags on the World Map when using refresh rates above 60Hz[/list]
[hr][/hr]
We thank you again for all of your messages, they have been proven extremely helpful to the development team to improve the quality of the game! Be sure to join our Discord (discord.gg/RogueLords) and to follow us on Twitter (Twitter.com/RogueLords) for updates about the game!

See you soon!

notes.title: A message from the Rogue Lords team!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The last few days have been quite an exciting period for everyone who worked on the game. You're all doing well to serve the will of the Devil (and obviously put Van Helsing in his place!), and we can't thank you enough for that.

Today, we want to share some of our plans for the near future.

[h2]Upcoming updates![/h2]
Over the next couple of days, we will fix some of the bugs and issues you've been reporting us (infinite loading, blocked path, audio issues, balancing, etc...) but also do our best to help the community to understand the mechanics of Rogue Lords.

[h2]The game is too difficult, please help me![/h2]
Rogue Lords in its core is a challenging experience, but we also don't want to make it an [b]impossible[/b] one.

So this week, members from our development team will help you on how to overcome some the most challenging battles and to use the powers of your Disciples and of the Devil to their full potential, until that time we can recommend you to watch streams and videos from content creators who've played the game and/or to join our [b]Discord Server[/b] (Discord.gg/RogueLords) to interact with other members of the community.

[H3]English streamers[/h3]
AdmiralBahroo: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1166434245?t=04h12m25s
Kripparrian: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1164035499?t=3h22m38s

[H3]French Streamer[/h3]
MisterMV: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1163678712

[H3]Russian streamers[/h3]
guit88man: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1164387456?t=00h18m47s

[hr][/hr]
We shall see you soon with more news about Rogue Lords, thank you for your support!
